title: AgentMV: A State-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Budget-Aware Music Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.10723v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generating a complete music video from a song requires more than synthesizing visually plausible clips for individual lyric prompts. A practical system must maintain long-range visual consistency, coordinate recurring motifs, synchronize edits with musical structure, and manage the cumulative cost of video generation. Existing approaches typically generate segments independently or adopt fixed generation strategies, limiting their ability to perform global planning over an entire song. We present AgentMV, a state-guided multi-agent framework for budget-aware music video generation. AgentMV decomposes the production process into specialized agents for music perception, script planning, visual asset provision, segment realization, and final assembly, coordinated through a Structured Persistent State that enables information exchange and state tracking throughout the generation process. translated_title: AgentMV：一种面向预算感知音乐视频生成的状态引导多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：从一首歌曲生成完整的音乐视频，不仅仅需要为单个歌词提示合成视觉上合理的片段。一个实用的系统必须保持长程视觉一致性，协调重复出现的主题，使编辑与音乐结构同步，并管理视频生成的累积成本。现有方法通常独立生成片段或采用固定生成策略，限制了其对整首歌曲进行全局规划的能力。我们提出了AgentMV，一种用于预算感知音乐视频生成的状态引导多智能体框架。AgentMV将制作过程分解为专门的智能体，分别负责音乐感知、脚本规划、视觉素材提供、片段实现和最终组装，并通过一个结构化的持久状态进行协调，该状态在整个生成过程中支持信息交换和状态跟踪。为了优化生成资源，我们公式化了...
tldr: AgentMV通过状态引导的多智能体框架和结构化持久状态，实现了预算感知的音乐视频生成，解决了长程一致性和全局规划问题。
en_tdlr: AgentMV achieves budget-aware music video generation through a state-guided multi-agent framework with structured persistent state, addressing long-range consistency and global planning.
